reason: Ten stores minimum at 8,000 each is 80,000 pesos a month, almost a million a year locked in, and that buys several more staff for my stores. A new company with no results can't show me how I get that back within the year.
objection: There's no payback number in pesos, only a simulation, and I'm signing 12 months with a company nobody has tested yet. My IT guy is already stretched with CCTV and POS, so I worry setup will land on him too.
would_change_my_mind: A paid pilot on 2-3 of my stores for 2-3 months, no 12-month lock-in, where I only continue if real POS sales in the test stores beat the control stores by more than the fee.
